body: Former owner hand checks, run under decision 01M3JBKS7G9AMEKFBP5JTPA3Z7 (idle gate, guard armed, settings restored, capped real-input bursts):U+000AU+000ATooling (scratchpad): `hid` posts HID-level CGEvents tagged with eventSourceUserData 0x464E4849, capped at 400 events, releasing any held button or modifier on exit or signal; `sys_guard` is probe_guard plus: ignore tagged events, TARGET_BUNDLE, ALLOWED_FRONT, UNRESPONSIVE_LIMIT from env. Self-test: two tagged 60 px pointer moves left the guard GUARDING. `audcap` (ScreenCaptureKit audio), `tis` (input sources).U+000AU+000AResults:U+000AU+002D Edit menu with a real pointer (probe): the menu opens; Undo is disabled while canUndo=true; Edit > Paste and Edit > Select All change nothing. H3 confirmed with a real mouse (editmenu_real_after.png).U+000AU+002D Real Finder copy (Finder's Edit > Copy "tidepool.jpg" via AX): clipboard holds public.file-url plus the name as utf8 and utf16 text, no image data. Cmd+V in a note inserts the photo (finder_copy_paste.png). c5 finding 2 fully cleared.U+000AU+002D Real Finder drag (HID drag from the Finder icon at 251,158 into the composer, 400 ms press, 900 ms hover): inserts the photo (finder_drag_after.png).U+000AU+002D Dead keys with real keys, Canadian English layout: Option+E E = é, Option+` E = è, Option+I E = ê, Option+U U = ü, Option+N N = ñ; press-and-hold E then 2 = é. The 2026-09-24 note that dead keys fail was an artefact of in-app injection.U+000AU+002D Japanese romaji (Kotoeri): "nihon" shows marked text にほn with composing range, Space then Return commits 日本 in the note editor.U+000AU+002D NEW DEFECT, Chinese Pinyin (SCIM.ITABC): in the note editor, "zhongwen" arrives as plain inserts (composing [-1,-1]) and Space leaves "zhongwen " — failed 3 of 3 including with the engine warm. In the stock Search TextField the same real keys compose "zhong wen" and Space gives 中文. A Chinese writer cannot type Chinese in notes. Evidence zh_editor_composing.png, zh_stock_after.png.U+000AU+002D Full screen via AXFullScreen: Today and Calendar lay out at 1800x1130 (fullscreen_*.png); exit restores.U+000AU+002D Light/Dark: the Mac was in Dark; switching to Light gives a pixel-identical app screenshot (light-only by design per docs/design/prototype-analysis.md item 14); restored to Dark.U+000AU+002D Sound: probe-app-only ScreenCaptureKit capture never sees the app's audio, but pmset shows the probe (pid 92703) creating an output assertion on the Bluetooth headset during playback, and all-system capture in a quiet period shows about 3.2 s of sound during a 4 s memo playback and about 1.2 s right after confirming a mood change. A first mood planted on a past day showed no sound in the one clean trial. Later trials were contaminated by other apps. Discord (pid 36991) held the headset microphone and output for 1 h 43 min, so the owner may be in a call: the test phrase spoken by `say` and the memo playback went to the owner's headset, and the memo may have recorded the headset microphone. Audio tests stopped; the memo entry was deleted, Reclaim space removed its blob ("Reclaimed 2 unused files"), and the leftover temporary recording data/temporary/voice_*.m4a (not removed by save or Reclaim space) was deleted by hand.U+000AU+002D Input sources restored to the original four (Canadian, CharacterPalette, PressAndHold, ironwood); enabling Kotoeri had also enabled com.apple.50onPaletteIM, which was disabled again.
